recommended_visible_summary: Kai Shin plans a commercial AI data-centre campus at Circular Park Kyushu, on the former Sendai thermal power station property in Satsumasendai. The July 18, 2026 location agreement outlines staged expansion from an initial pilot to a proposed 350 MW. The prefecture targets March 2033 and estimates investment of about JPY 850 billion at that scale, subject to change. The city reported continuing development preparations on October 8. Its concept allocates about 15 hectares to data-centre use within the 25-hectare host property.
